title: A C¹ image is covered, up to an H^n-null set, by countably many images of balls carrying lower Lipschitz bounds
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let G : ℝ^n → ℝ^P be a C¹ map. Then there are points c_k ∈ ℝ^n, reals r_k and constants m_k > 0 (k ∈ ℕ) with two properties. (i) m_k|a − b| ≤ |G(a) − G(b)| for all a, b in the open ball B_{r_k}(c_k), which is empty when r_k ≤ 0. (ii) H^n(G(ℝ^n) ∖ ⋃_k G(B_{r_k}(c_k))) = 0, where H^n = μHE[n] on ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (G : Euclid n → Euclid P), ContDiff ℝ 1 G → ∃ (c : ℕ → Euclid n) (r m : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ k, 0 < m k) ∧ (∀ k, ∀ a ∈ ball (c k) (r k), ∀ b ∈ ball (c k) (r k), m k * ‖a - b‖ ≤ ‖G a - G b‖) ∧ μHE[n] (range G \ ⋃ k, G '' ball (c k) (r k)) = 0
